title: SLGO team select menu payload (team.menu)
description: The viewer's team select session, owned by the plugin (its M key, or a join without a team). One recipient per publish; sent only to clients declaring team-select. Rosters come from match.snapshot.

menu.description: null while no session is open (also the first frame after the client declares team-select).

session_id.description: The plugin's session id as a decimal string; every new session has a new id. command.team.close names it.

forced.description: Opened because the player joined without a team: no Cancel, Escape and M do nothing; Spectate is the way out.
